reference: A4 exact pre-dopamine state and its existing no_update/real_full frozen 32-note probes; reject the run if either reference does not reproduce exactly.
omission_rule: Construct the exact real full update through the production plasticity method. For the intervention only, restore the pre-update weights at every selected plastic edge whose existing sensory parent has preferred_time_to_contact_us == 300000. All other effective weights equal the full real branch exactly. Do not redistribute, renormalize, rescale or alter clipping of retained edges.
probe: From the identical true pre-dopamine checkpoint, advance the dopamine/plasticity clock once, freeze plasticity and exploration, use the same A4 32-note relative-time/cue-gain panel and preserve all other state. Record every outcome, DOWN, signed scored attempt, motor spike tick, readout threshold crossing and readout decision.
primary_timing_measure: Mean paired signed scored-attempt error versus no_update on the 32 matched note indices. Negative is earlier. The full reference advance is -61.71875 ms. Also report paired shift of omission versus real_full, mean/median of all DOWN nearest-note offsets and hit-only MAE where defined.
interpretation_declared_before_branch_c: First classify as nonlinear/mechanistically ambiguous if the intervention has fewer than 32 paired scored attempts, a DOWN count other than 64, or a qualitatively changed null/scored-action pattern. Otherwise let full_advance=abs(real_full minus no_update mean paired signed error), remaining_advance=abs(real_except_300ms minus no_update mean paired signed error). If the intervention shift has the opposite sign from the full shift, treat as at least substantially removed, while reporting the sign change. If remaining_advance <= 0.50*full_advance, the 300-ms bin is a major necessary contributor in this state. If remaining_advance >= 0.75*full_advance with the same early sign, it is not necessary here; other far-cue components suffice. The intermediate 0.50-0.75 interval is contributory but does not establish necessity. Do not call a missing paired timing value a delayed press or search other bins.
scope: Exactly one omitted cue bin at one previously selected synthetic checkpoint. Diagnostic only; no learning-rule change, parameter tuning, new training or fly claim.
